Limitations: This review checks dated evidence integrity and chronology, not fresh visual rendering or gameplay. Original author observations remain attributed to the retained source report.

Final gameplay visual review sampled six targeted screenshots after an earlier twenty-six-image review; equipment review sampled twenty of fifty-four captures. Do not generalize to every state, pixel, live account, transaction, battle or mouse/touch interaction.
Long-attribute screenshots do not independently prove scrolling to the final row. Skills and other modules remain outside this review.

The earlier gameplay QA images were deliberately deleted after the dated final review. Their historical hashes and cleanup disposition are preserved; deleted files are not regenerated, restored or migrated.
The report-writing script hardcodes observer conclusions and relies on earlier screenshots now absent. Keep it as source provenance only, not an automatic acceptance tool.
No actual model/quality/time provenance is added or inferred; this batch creates no new art or runtime payload.
No QA images, raw logs or compiled outputs are selected for upload by this review.
Source completeness and complete migration of both computers remain unproven.
